moments.title: Madonna turns 68
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, celebrates her 68th birthday today, still making headlines with her new chart entry with Kylie Minogue.

angles.name: Queen of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the one and only Queen of Pop, Madonna! Still ruling the charts and our playlists.

angles.name: New Chart Hit
angles.copy: From 'Holiday' to a brand new Top 10 hit with Kylie, Madonna turns 68 today! What's your favourite Madonna era?

moments.title: Official Singles Chart update
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold the #1 spot for a record-breaking 61st week with 'Rein Me In', while Madonna & Kylie Minogue make a huge new entry at #8 with 'Love Sensation'.

angles.name: #1 Dominance
angles.copy: 61 weeks at Number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still dominating the Official Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'. Can anyone stop them?

angles.name: New Entry Buzz
angles.copy: Chart Alert! Madonna & Kylie Minogue's 'Love Sensation' is a massive new entry at No. 8 on the Official Singles Chart. Pop royalty unite!

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season gets underway this Friday, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Season Start
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Premier League season kicks off this Friday. Who are you backing for the title?

angles.name: Opening Weekend
angles.copy: Get ready for a huge weekend of football! The Premier League returns on Friday with Arsenal vs Coventry City. What's your score prediction?

moments.title: We Out Here Festival begins
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, celebrating genre-hopping music and UK club culture, takes place in Wimborne St Giles, Dorset, from August 20-23. It is officially sold out.

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival kicks off in Dorset this Thursday! Four days of incredible music, wellness, and culture. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: Sold Out Success
angles.copy: Another sold-out success! We Out Here Festival brings its unique blend of jazz, club culture and more to Dorset from August 20-23.

moments.title: Liam Howlett (The Prodigy) turns 55
moments.blurb: Liam Howlett, the mastermind behind electronic music pioneers The Prodigy, celebrates his 55th birthday on August 21st.

source.l: This Day In Music / Famous Birthdays

angles.name: Prodigy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Liam Howlett of The Prodigy! The man who brought us 'Firestarter' and changed electronic music forever.

moments.title: Serj Tankian (System Of A Down) turns 58
moments.blurb: Serj Tankian, the distinctive vocalist and frontman of System Of A Down, celebrates his 58th birthday on August 21st.

source.l: Famous Birthdays / This Day In Music

angles.name: SOAD Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 58th Birthday to the incredible Serj Tankian of System Of A Down! What's your favourite SOAD track?

moments.title: Dua Lipa turns 31
moments.blurb: Global pop superstar Dua Lipa celebrates her 31st birthday on August 22nd.

angles.name: Pop Queen
angles.copy: Happy 31st Birthday to the sensational Dua Lipa! From 'New Rules' to 'Radical Optimism', she keeps delivering the hits.

moments.title: Roland Orzabal (Tears for Fears) turns 65
moments.blurb: Roland Orzabal, co-founder of the iconic new wave band Tears for Fears, celebrates his 65th birthday on August 22nd.

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to Roland Orzabal of Tears for Fears! Relive the 80s with classics like 'Everybody Wants To Rule The World'.

moments.title: All Points East Festival kicks off
moments.blurb: London's All Points East festival brings a diverse lineup of artists to Victoria Park from August 21st to 30th.

angles.name: London Festival
angles.copy: All Points East returns to Victoria Park this Friday! London, are you ready for 10 days of incredible music?

angles.name: Festival Lineup
angles.copy: Who are you excited to see at All Points East? Kicking off this weekend, it's set to be one of London's biggest summer events!

moments.title: Shaun Ryder (Happy Mondays) turns 64
moments.blurb: The charismatic frontman of Happy Mondays and Black Grape, Shaun Ryder, celebrates his 64th birthday on August 23rd.

angles.name: Madchester Legend
angles.copy: Step On! Happy 64th Birthday to the Madchester icon, Shaun Ryder! What's your favourite Happy Mondays or Black Grape track?

moments.title: Elvis Costello turns 72
moments.blurb: Influential singer-songwriter Elvis Costello celebrates his 72nd birthday on August 25th.

source.l: AP News / This Day In Music

angles.name: Music Icon
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday to the legendary Elvis Costello! His incredible songwriting continues to inspire generations.

moments.title: Gene Simmons (Kiss) turns 77

source.l: AP News / This Day In Music

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: You wanted the best, you got the best! Happy 77th Birthday to KISS's legendary 'Demon', Gene Simmons!

moments.title: Creamfields Festival starts
moments.blurb: One of the UK's biggest electronic dance music festivals, Creamfields, takes place in Cheshire from August 27th to 29th.

angles.name: Dance Festival
angles.copy: Creamfields is almost here! Get ready for three days of the biggest names in dance music in Cheshire, starting Thursday.

angles.name: Festival Weekend
angles.copy: Who's heading to Creamfields this Bank Holiday weekend? The ultimate dance music experience awaits!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals begin
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading & Leeds Festivals, two of the UK's biggest music events, run concurrently from August 28th to 30th.

angles.name: Festival Season Finale
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds Festivals kick off this Friday! Who are you seeing and what are you most excited for?

angles.name: Double Trouble
angles.copy: Two iconic festivals, one massive weekend! Reading & Leeds are back from August 28-30. Let the good times roll!

moments.title: Shania Twain turns 61

angles.name: Country Queen
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to the one and only Shania Twain! Let's go girls, what's your favourite Shania hit?

source.l: AP News / This Day In Music

angles.name: Indie Icon
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to the incredible Florence Welch! Her powerful voice and ethereal style continue to mesmerise us.

moments.title: August Bank Holiday approaching
moments.blurb: The UK's August Bank Holiday weekend (England, Wales, and Northern Ireland) is just around the corner, falling on Monday, August 31st, 2026.

angles.name: Long Weekend Prep
angles.copy: Bank Holiday countdown is ON! The last long weekend of summer is just days away. What are your plans?

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: Make the most of the last official summer long weekend! The August Bank Holiday is Monday 31st. Time for some fun!
